### Uuid7 {#type-commerz-identity-uuid7}

`Commerz\Identity\Uuid7`

Time-ordered UUIDv7 generator (RFC 9562, method 1: a 12-bit counter keeps ids from one process strictly increasing inside a millisecond). Tests pin ids with `fixed()`.

```php
final class Uuid7 {
    // Makes `generate()` return the given ids in order; running out is a test error.
    static fixed(string ...$uuids): void;
    static generate(): string;
    static reset(): void;
}
```

### Money {#type-commerz-money-money}

`Commerz\Money\Money`

An amount in integer minor units of one currency. Arithmetic never leaves int64 silently.

```php
final readonly class Money {
    public readonly int $amountMinor;
    public readonly \Commerz\Money\Currency $currency;
    __construct(int $amountMinor, \Commerz\Money\Currency $currency);
    compare(self $other): int;
    equals(self $other): bool;
    // The part of this amount that is already tax at `$rate`: `round(amount × bp / (10000 + bp))`, to a whole minor unit. For a gross price of 1220.00 at 22% it is 220.00.
    includedPart(\Commerz\Money\Rate $rate, \Commerz\Money\RoundingMode $mode): self;
    isNegative(): bool;
    isPositive(): bool;
    isZero(): bool;
    minus(self $other): self;
    multiply(int $factor): self;
    negate(): self;
    // Parses a decimal string by the currency exponent: Money::of('19.90', 'RUB') is 1990 minor units. Extra fraction digits are rejected, never rounded.
    static of(string $amount, \Commerz\Money\Currency|string $currency): self;
    static ofMinor(int $amountMinor, \Commerz\Money\Currency|string $currency): self;
    // The share of this amount at `$rate`, rounded to a whole minor unit.
    percentage(\Commerz\Money\Rate $rate, \Commerz\Money\RoundingMode $mode): self;
    plus(self $other): self;
    // The amount as a decimal string by the currency exponent, e.g. '19.90'.
    toDecimal(): string;
    static zero(\Commerz\Money\Currency|string $currency): self;
}
```

### MoneyAllocator {#type-commerz-money-moneyallocator}

`Commerz\Money\MoneyAllocator`

Splits an amount by weights so the parts sum exactly to the whole (largest remainder method).

```php
final readonly class MoneyAllocator {
    // Zero weights get nothing; equal remainders go to the lowest index first. A negative total is split by its magnitude and the sign restored.
    static allocate(\Commerz\Money\Money $total, array $weights): array;
}
```

`Commerz\Money\Rate`

A non-negative ratio in basis points: 2000 = 20%.

```php
final readonly class Rate {
    public readonly int $basisPoints;
    __construct(int $basisPoints);
    static bp(int $basisPoints): self;

    // Parses a percent decimal such as '20' or '12.5'; at most two fraction digits (one basis point).

}
```

### RoundingMode {#type-commerz-money-roundingmode}

`Commerz\Money\RoundingMode`

How a fractional minor unit is resolved. `Up`/`Down` act on magnitude; `Ceiling`/`Floor` on the signed value.

```php
enum RoundingMode {
    case HalfUp = 'half_up';
    case HalfDown = 'half_down';
    case HalfEven = 'half_even';
    case Up = 'up';
    case Down = 'down';
    case Ceiling = 'ceiling';
    case Floor = 'floor';
    toBrick(): \Brick\Math\RoundingMode;
}
```

### CommittedEvents {#type-commerz-operations-contracts-committedevents}

`Commerz\Operations\Contracts\CommittedEvents`

Dispatches a domain (Laravel) event once the surrounding transaction on the Commerz connection (`commerz.connection`) commits — ours or the host's. Outside a transaction the event is dispatched at once; on rollback it is dropped.

```php

    dispatch(object $event): void;
}
```

Database transactions on the Commerz connection (`commerz.connection`).

```php
interface Transactions {
    inTransaction(): bool;
    run(callable $work, int $lockTimeoutMs = 3000): mixed;
}
```

### Fingerprint {#type-commerz-operations-fingerprint}

`Commerz\Operations\Fingerprint`

sha256 (64 hex) of the canonical JSON of a request payload: map keys sorted recursively, list order kept, `Stringable` and backed enums as their string value. Used for `OperationReceipts::once()` and the schema fingerprint; equal payloads give equal fingerprints across processes and PHP versions.

```php
final class Fingerprint {
    static of(mixed $payload): string;
}
```

### Outbox {#type-commerz-outbox-contracts-outbox}

`Commerz\Outbox\Contracts\Outbox`

Transactional outbox: an event is stored in the same transaction as the change it describes and delivered by `commerz:outbox:relay` after commit, at least once.

```php
interface Outbox {
    record(\Commerz\Outbox\Data\IntegrationEvent $event): void;
}
```

### OutboxConsumer {#type-commerz-outbox-contracts-outboxconsumer}

`Commerz\Outbox\Contracts\OutboxConsumer`

Receives every relayed event. Registered by a plugin: `$registrar->contribute(OutboxConsumer::KIND, MyConsumer::class)`. Delivery is at least once and in no guaranteed order across retries: deduplicate by `eventId` and ignore types you do not handle. Throwing schedules the event for a later retry, which reaches every consumer again. Runs outside the relay's database transaction.

```php
interface OutboxConsumer {
    const KIND = 'outbox_consumer';
    consume(\Commerz\Outbox\Data\IntegrationEvent $event): void;
    // Stable key, `vendor.name`.
    key(): string;
}
```

### IntegrationEvent {#type-commerz-outbox-data-integrationevent}

`Commerz\Outbox\Data\IntegrationEvent`

A fact published to other systems through the outbox. `type` is a dotted stable name (`sales.order_placed`), `version` the payload schema version, `aggregateRef` the `type:id` the fact is about. Consumers deduplicate by `eventId`: delivery is at least once.

```php
final readonly class IntegrationEvent {
    public readonly string $aggregateRef;
    public readonly string $eventId;
    public readonly \DateTimeImmutable $occurredAt;
    public readonly array $payload;
    public readonly string $type;
    public readonly int $version;
    __construct(string $eventId, string $type, int $version, string $aggregateRef, array $payload, \DateTimeImmutable $occurredAt);
    // A new event with a fresh UUIDv7 id, occurring now unless `$occurredAt` is given.
    static of(string $type, \Commerz\Identity\Ref|string $aggregateRef, array $payload, int $version = 1, ?\DateTimeImmutable $occurredAt = null): self;
}
```

### IntegrationEventDelivered {#type-commerz-outbox-events-integrationeventdelivered}

`Commerz\Outbox\Events\IntegrationEventDelivered`

Laravel event dispatched by the outbox relay for each delivered event; same guarantees as `OutboxConsumer`.

```php
final readonly class IntegrationEventDelivered {
    public readonly \Commerz\Outbox\Data\IntegrationEvent $event;
    __construct(\Commerz\Outbox\Data\IntegrationEvent $event);
}
```

```php
    restore(\Commerz\Ports\Promotions\Data\RestorePromotionUsage $command): void;
}
```

`Commerz\Ports\Sellables\Contracts\SellableProvider`

Source of sellables of one ref type: the catalog provides `variant`, a CRM its own services. Registered as the `sellable_provider` contribution (`PluginRegistrar::contribute(SellableProvider::KIND, ...)`); `key()` is the ref type it serves. Reads only: no writes, no network calls inside a database transaction.

```php
interface SellableProvider {
    const KIND = 'sellable_provider';
    // The `SellableRef` type served, e.g. `variant` or `crm.service`.
    key(): string;
    // Unknown refs are left out of the result; the router reports them as unavailable.
    resolve(array $refs, \Commerz\Context\CommerceContext $context): array;
}
```

`Commerz\Ports\Sellables\Contracts\Sellables`

Resolves anything sellable to a snapshot by routing `SellableRef::$type` to the `SellableProvider` with that key. A snapshot that is not `purchasable` is still returned; callers decide whether to sell it.

```php
interface Sellables {
    resolve(\Commerz\Identity\SellableRef $ref, \Commerz\Context\CommerceContext $context): \Commerz\Ports\Sellables\Data\SellableSnapshot;
    // Duplicate refs are resolved once.
    resolveMany(array $refs, \Commerz\Context\CommerceContext $context): array;
}
```

### StockReservations {#type-commerz-ports-stock-contracts-stockreservations}

`Commerz\Ports\Stock\Contracts\StockReservations`

Holds stock for a demand (`order:{id}`). Every mutation joins the caller's database transaction on the Commerz connection (or opens its own when there is none), owns its locking and makes no network calls, so an order placement commits or rolls back reservations together with the order.

```php
interface StockReservations {
    // Turns held stock into a sale (stock leaves on fulfilment); may be partial. Not idempotent per reference: the caller deduplicates its fulfilment document.
    consume(\Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\ConsumeReservation $command): void;
    // Gives held stock back, by demand or one of its sellables. Releasing what is not held is a no-op.
    release(\Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\ReleaseReservation $command): void;
    // All lines or nothing. Idempotent per demand: reserving a demand that already holds stock returns what it holds.
    reserve(\Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\ReserveStock $command): \Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\ReservationResult;
}
```

### StockReturns {#type-commerz-ports-stock-contracts-stockreturns}

`Commerz\Ports\Stock\Contracts\StockReturns`

Puts returned units back on hand (REF-01: stock returns only through an explicit restock, never implicitly). Joins the caller's database transaction on the Commerz connection (or opens its own when there is none), so an accepted return commits or rolls back together with its restock.

```php
interface StockReturns {
    // Idempotent per reference: restocking a reference that was already restocked changes nothing.
    restock(\Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\RestockStock $command): void;
}
```

### QuotePipeline {#type-commerz-quotes-contracts-quotepipeline}

`Commerz\Quotes\Contracts\QuotePipeline`

Prices a set of lines: runs every registered `QuoteStage` in anchor order. Pure calculation: it writes nothing, opens no transaction, and the same input with the same stages gives the same result and fingerprint.

```php
interface QuotePipeline {
    run(\Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteInput $input): \Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteResult;
}
```

### QuoteStage {#type-commerz-quotes-contracts-quotestage}

`Commerz\Quotes\Contracts\QuoteStage`

One step of the quote pipeline, registered as the `quote_stage` contribution (`PluginRegistrar::contribute(QuoteStage::KIND, ...)`). Stages run by anchor, then `Before → At → After`, then key. A stage is a pure function of the state: it may read (prices, rules) but never writes to the database or calls the network, and takes the time from the context. Any exception it throws fails the quote with `QuoteFailed`.

```php
interface QuoteStage {
    const KIND = 'quote_stage';
    anchor(): \Commerz\Quotes\Enums\QuoteAnchor;
    apply(\Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteState $state): \Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteState;
    key(): string;
    position(): \Commerz\Quotes\Enums\StagePosition;
}
```

### Adjustment {#type-commerz-quotes-data-adjustment}

`Commerz\Quotes\Data\Adjustment`

A price reduction with its reason. `$target` says where it was declared; `$lineId` names the line it is carried by: required for `Line`, never set for `Delivery`, and set for `Order` only on the per-line shares the totals stage allocates (a quote result line lists its own adjustments and its shares of order-level ones).

```php
final readonly class Adjustment {
    public readonly \Commerz\Money\Money $amount;
    public readonly ?string $couponCode;
    public readonly string $explanation;
    public readonly ?string $lineId;
    public readonly ?string $promotionId;
    public readonly string $source;
    public readonly \Commerz\Quotes\Enums\AdjustmentTarget $target;
    __construct(\Commerz\Quotes\Enums\AdjustmentTarget $target, ?string $lineId, \Commerz\Money\Money $amount, string $source, string $explanation, ?string $promotionId = null, ?string $couponCode = null);
    // This order-level adjustment's share carried by one line.
    allocatedTo(string $lineId, \Commerz\Money\Money $share): self;
    static delivery(\Commerz\Money\Money $amount, string $source, string $explanation, ?string $promotionId = null, ?string $couponCode = null): self;
    static line(string $lineId, \Commerz\Money\Money $amount, string $source, string $explanation, ?string $promotionId = null, ?string $couponCode = null): self;
    static order(\Commerz\Money\Money $amount, string $source, string $explanation, ?string $promotionId = null, ?string $couponCode = null): self;
}
```

`Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteResult`

```php
final readonly class QuoteResult {
    public readonly array $codes;
    public readonly \Commerz\Context\CommerceContext $context;
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Quotes\Data\DeliveryCharge $delivery;
    public readonly array $deliveryAdjustments;
    public readonly string $fingerprint;
    public readonly array $lines;
    public readonly array $orderAdjustments;
    public readonly array $rejections;
    public readonly array $taxLines;
    public readonly \Commerz\Money\Money $total;
    public readonly \Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteTotals $totals;
    __construct(\Commerz\Context\CommerceContext $context, array $lines, array $orderAdjustments, ?\Commerz\Quotes\Data\DeliveryCharge $delivery, array $deliveryAdjustments, array $taxLines, \Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteTotals $totals, array $rejections, array $codes, string $fingerprint);
    // What each promotion took off this quote, for PromotionUsage::consume when the order is placed: one entry per promotion id, in order of first appearance — own line adjustments of the lines (lines in order), then the order-level adjustments as declared, then the delivery adjustments. The per-line shares of order-level adjustments are not counted again. Adjustments without a promotion id (host stages) are ignored.
    appliedPromotions(): array;
}
```

### QuoteState {#type-commerz-quotes-data-quotestate}

`Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteState`

The immutable state passed from stage to stage. The base stage prices the input lines; later stages add adjustments, delivery, taxes and rejections; the totals stage settles it. Any change to amounts after settling drops the totals, so a stage after `totals` cannot leave a result that does not add up.

```php
final readonly class QuoteState {
    public readonly array $adjustments;
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Quotes\Data\DeliveryCharge $delivery;
    public readonly \Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteInput $input;
    public readonly array $lines;
    public readonly array $rejections;
    public readonly array $settledLines;
    public readonly array $taxLines;
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteTotals $totals;
    // Shares of every order-level adjustment carried by the lines, in adjustment order then line order: each one is spread by MoneyAllocator over what is left of each line (its net after line adjustments and earlier shares), so no line goes below zero and the shares add up exactly. The same split the totals stage settles, so a tax computed on it matches the settled lines to the minor unit.
    allocatedOrderAdjustments(): array;
    context(): \Commerz\Context\CommerceContext;
    currency(): \Commerz\Money\Currency;
    // Delivery price after delivery adjustments, or null without a delivery charge.
    deliveryNet(): ?\Commerz\Money\Money;
    // Sum of all line nets, before order-level adjustments.
    itemsNet(): \Commerz\Money\Money;
    line(string $lineId): ?\Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteLine;
    // The line's subtotal after its own line adjustments: the base for later line discounts and allocation.
    lineNet(string $lineId): \Commerz\Money\Money;
    static start(\Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteInput $input): self;
    withAdjustment(\Commerz\Quotes\Data\Adjustment $adjustment): self;
    withDelivery(?\Commerz\Quotes\Data\DeliveryCharge $delivery): self;
    // Adds the line, or replaces the line with the same id. The id must come from the input.
    withLine(\Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteLine $line): self;
    // Recording a rejection does not change amounts, so it keeps settled totals.
    withRejection(\Commerz\Quotes\Data\Rejection $rejection): self;
    withTaxLine(\Commerz\Quotes\Data\TaxLine $tax): self;
    // Settles the quote; called by the totals stage.
    withTotals(array $lines, \Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteTotals $totals): self;
}
```

### QuoteFailed {#type-commerz-quotes-exceptions-quotefailed}

`Commerz\Quotes\Exceptions\QuoteFailed`

The quote cannot be computed. `$stage` is the stage that failed; `$reason` is `stage_error` when the stage threw (the original exception is the previous one, its code in `context()['cause']`), or a totals check such as `negative_total`, `negative_line`, `negative_delivery`, `delivery_without_charge`, `unpriced_line` or `totals_missing`.

```php
final class QuoteFailed extends \Commerz\Errors\CommerzException implements \Stringable, \Throwable {
    public readonly string $reason;
    public readonly string $stage;
    __construct(string $stage, string $reason, string $message, ?\Throwable $previous = null);
    static byStage(string $stage, \Throwable $error): self;
    category(): \Packman\Errors\Enums\ErrorCategory;
    code(): string;
    context(): array;
    errorDescriptor(): \Packman\Errors\Data\ErrorDescriptor;
}
```

### CommerzMigration {#type-commerz-schema-commerzmigration}

`Commerz\Schema\CommerzMigration`

Runs migrations with the Commerz table prefix and connection.

```php
abstract class CommerzMigration extends \Packman\Schema\Laravel\PackmanMigration {
    getConnection(): ?string;
    protected table(string $logical): string;
    protected tables(): \Packman\Schema\Data\Compiler\TableNames;
}
```

### CommerzSchemaSets {#type-commerz-schema-commerzschemasets}

`Commerz\Schema\CommerzSchemaSets`

Declares the central PostgreSQL schema set owned by `axiomasoft/commerz` and governs Laravel migration execution across all registered Commerz `SchemaSet` declarations.

```php
final readonly class CommerzSchemaSets implements \Packman\Schema\Contracts\Migration\SchemaSetProvider {
    // Validates that the configured Commerz database connection satisfies every registered Commerz `SchemaSet`.
    static assertConnectionSupported(\Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application $app): void;
    // Registers Commerz `SchemaSet` paths with Laravel's `migrator` and guards execution so unsupported database drivers fail cleanly with {@see SchemaSetException} before creating partial commerce tables.
    static governMigrations(\Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application $app): void;
    sets(): array;
}
```

### TableNames {#type-commerz-schema-tablenames}

`Commerz\Schema\TableNames`

Resolves tables in the Commerz schema configured for this application.

```php
final class TableNames {
    const OWNER = 'axiomasoft/commerz-core';
    __construct(\Closure $resolve);
    connection(): ?string;
    prefix(): string;
    resolver(): \Packman\Schema\Data\Compiler\TableNames;
    table(string $logical): string;
    static verifyFingerprint(\Illuminate\Database\ConnectionInterface $connection, string $prefix): void;
}
```

### UpdateChannel {#type-commerz-stores-data-updatechannel}

`Commerz\Stores\Data\UpdateChannel`

Changes the given fields; a null field stays as it is. The code and store never change. The resulting default currency and locale must stay inside the resulting lists; the service checks that against the stored channel.

```php
final readonly class UpdateChannel {
    public readonly \Commerz\Stores\Data\ChannelId $channel;
    public readonly ?array $currencies;
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Money\Currency $defaultCurrency;
    public readonly ?string $defaultLocale;
    public readonly ?array $locales;
    public readonly ?string $name;
    public readonly ?bool $pricesIncludeTax;
    __construct(\Commerz\Stores\Data\ChannelId $channel, ?string $name = null, ?array $currencies = null, ?array $locales = null, ?bool $pricesIncludeTax = null, ?\Commerz\Money\Currency $defaultCurrency = null, ?string $defaultLocale = null);
}
```
